gags.text: the man in the black hoodie climbs over the wooden fence from behind the apple tree and drops into the yard while the Shiba looks up at him
the man bends forward and pats and strokes the Shiba's head; the Shiba leans in and wags its tail, friendly, no barking
the man reaches up with both arms, pulls an apple-laden branch down and picks red apples, tucking them into his hoodie; the Shiba stands beside him watching calmly

gags.en: climbs back out with the apples
gags.text: the man turns, grabs the top of the fence and climbs back over it and out of sight; the Shiba just watches, tail wagging
the Shiba alone sniffs the ground where the man stood, then turns and looks toward the camera, tail wagging as if nothing happened
